title: One app Saga
statement: A repository has one app.saga that holds material about the whole application plus its epics, so every story has one current version and outlives the change that introduced it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Material about the whole application sits at the root (the overview, personas, design system, onboarding deck, and feature flags); everything else belongs to an epic under ___epics.
saga.json holds identity and repository only; it holds no comparison.
